result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: vertically misaligned cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and inconsistent favorite-button styling in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' row are not vertically aligned - the middle 'Smash Bros Burgers' card sits noticeably lower than the cards on either side, and the '15-25 min' / '20-30 min' badges are at different vertical positions within their images.
issues.suggestion: Align all cards in the horizontal list to a common top baseline and anchor the time badges consistently to the bottom-left of each image.

issues.description: Favorite heart button on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has no background container while the card below it shows the heart inside a dark circular scrim, making the first one look missing or unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark circular background container to all favorite buttons for consistent visibility, contrast and touch target.
